sonnet.problem: The card links the ground in verse 4 to the Maker of verse 6, saying God is the One who MADE the ground the prince goes back to. The psalm states no such link. It says only that the man returns to the ground (v4) and that the LORD is the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea and everything in them (v6). The card also uses verse 4's "the ground" as if it were verse 6's "earth".
sonnet.rule: When he connects two passages, or explains what a law was for, he says only what the texts state.
